dog.description_text:
Reacher is a 4-year-old French Bulldog who weighs around 27 lbs and is doing amazingly well as a tripod. Three legs have not slowed him down much at all. He has plenty of zest, can still put some enthusiasm into his leash walks, and generally prefers keeping them on the shorter side.

He loves meeting people, seems especially fond of women, and is comfortable around other dogs. Reacher is doing well with house-training and has a very sweet, silly personality. He also has an adorable little tappy-tap cha-cha dance when you scratch his butt, and once he likes you, he tends to stay very close.

Registered adopters interested in Reacher can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
